title: Gates Cambridge Scholarship 2025
eligibility: Open to citizens of any country outside the United Kingdom applying to pursue a full-time postgraduate degree at the University of Cambridge.
qualification: Bachelor's degree or equivalent with outstanding academic record
description: Provides full-cost scholarships to outstanding applicants from outside the UK to pursue a full-time postgraduate degree in any subject available at the University of Cambridge, emphasizing leadership and commitment to improving the lives of others.

title: Software Engineering Intern - Summer 2025
eligibility: Currently enrolled in a Bachelor's, Master's, or PhD degree program in Computer Science or related technical field.
qualification: Pursuing CS degree; proficiency in C++, Java, Python, or Go
description: Join Google engineering teams for 12 to 14 weeks to build real-world software products, solve complex scalable system challenges, and collaborate with full-time software engineering mentors.

title: Frontend Engineer (React/TypeScript)
eligibility: Qualified web developers globally with strong asynchronous communication skills.
qualification: Solid expertise in JavaScript, React, HTML/CSS, and web performance optimization
description: Work remotely from anywhere in the world building web interfaces for platforms like WordPress.com, WooCommerce, and Tumblr, serving hundreds of millions of users globally.

title: Associate Product Manager (APM)
eligibility: Recent university graduates or early career professionals with 0-2 years of experience.
qualification: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or quantitative field
description: A rotational product management program designed to train future leaders by providing direct ownership over major feature developments across Meta's app family.

title: Imagine Cup 2025 Global Student Competition
eligibility: Students aged 18+ enrolled in high school or higher education globally.
salary: Up to $100,000 USD Grand Prize + Microsoft Azure Credits
qualification: Student teams leveraging AI and cloud technologies for impact
description: Microsoft's global technology competition inviting young innovators to build original software projects using Microsoft Azure Cloud and AI capabilities to tackle pressing global challenges.

title: CS50: Introduction to Computer Science
eligibility: Open globally to anyone interested in computer science; no prior experience required.
description: An entry-level computer science course taught by Professor David J. Malan that covers algorithmic thinking, data structures, software engineering principles, and languages including C, Python, SQL, and JavaScript.
